questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
options: had
has
would have
was having

questions.question: Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the concert,' she said to me.
options: She said that she had enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had enjoyed the concert.
She said that she had enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had enjoyed the concert.
questions.answer: She said to me that she had enjoyed the concert.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice? Choose the option that is grammatically correct.
options: The letter was written by Mary.
The letter was written by Mary.
The letter was written by Mary.
The letter was written by Mary.
questions.answer: The letter was written by Mary.

questions.question: Identify the correct form of the conditional sentence: If I (be) ________ you, I would have taken that job.
options: were
was
had been
would be

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to report the following direct speech? 'I don't believe it,' he said.
options: He said that he didn't believe it.
He said that he didn't believe it.
He said that he didn't believe it.
He said that he didn't believe it.
questions.answer: He said that he didn't believe it.

questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the collocation: It's important to keep ________ with current events.
options: informed
up to date
current
updated

questions.question: Select the correct preposition to complete the phrase: She was reluctant ________ the idea.
options: to
with
from
about

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional? Choose the option that is grammatically correct.
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Choose the best word to complete the sentence: We're going to have to ________ with a smaller budget.
options: manage
cope
deal
adjust

questions.question: Which of these sentences correctly uses a discourse marker to express concession?
options: But, I think we need to reconsider our approach.
However, I think we need to reconsider our approach.
Nevertheless, I think we need to reconsider our approach.
On the other hand, I think we need to reconsider our approach.
questions.answer: However, I think we need to reconsider our approach.
